tools.name: createWebsite
tools.description: Creates a new website or webshop draft from a plain-language description. All properties can be changed afterwards by the user.

tools.name: getFeatures
tools.description: Shows the features of all versions or a specific version together with a link to the documentation page of each feature.

tools.name: getPrices
tools.description: Shows the price of each version in EUR, USD or other currencies.

tools.name: supportSearch
tools.description: Searches in the Documentation and FAQ to repond to users' questions.
